leadText:
Alternate World Chloe (Japanese: のコハル Alternate World Koharu) is a character of the day who appeared in Showdown at the Gates of Warp!. She is Chloe's counterpart from the .

Alternate Chloe first appeared in Canalave City, from where she and Alternate World Goh picked up Alternate World Ash and Dawn up before heading to the Spear Pillar, having been called to do so by regular Goh. When Dawn and Ash noticed that Alternate Goh's Pokémon weren't being rewound, Alternate World Chloe explained that she had hacked into Alternate World Team Rocket's database and constructed copies of the suits they were using to protect them and their Pokémon from the time reversal.

Alternate Chloe later participated in the battle against Alternate World Team Rocket, until a power burst from destroyed her protective suit and caused her, along with every other person present, to turn younger and sent Team Rocket blasting off. , Goh, , Chloe, and their alternate counterparts prayed for to stop Dialga and 's fight, which it did, allowing the two Legendary Pokémon to undo the time reversal and return all the devolved Pokémon back to normal. Alternate World Chloe and regular Chloe bid farewell as the latter was returned to her own world.
